name: Curing the Sick
summary: Sick gazelles are suffering across the northern Barrens. Tonga Runetotem sends young Horde druids to treat them with a freshly made herbal salve, then sends them before the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.

sections.title: A Plague upon the Herds
sections.body: An unnatural sickness is spreading among gazelles in the northern Barrens. You have gathered earthroot and kodo horns for a curative remedy, and Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads now entrusts the animals to your care. Search north of the main crossroads and tend to ten suffering gazelles. The salve brings them relief before the affliction takes deeper hold in the ecosystem.

sections.title: The Circle's Blessing
sections.body: After you apply the salve, you travel to Moonglade’s tranquil druidic sanctuary. Dendrite Starblaze recognizes your compassion and vigilance there. He says the gazelles’ suffering points to a deeper corruption stalking Kalimdor’s wilderness. By tending even the lowliest beasts, tauren druids show that reverence for Cenarius reaches beyond tribal boundaries. They earn deeper secrets of poison cleansing and nature magic.

faq.q: Where are the sickly gazelles found?
faq.answer: The afflicted gazelles roam the arid plains of the northern Barrens, mainly north of the main east-west trade road that meets at the Crossroads.
Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, gives you this work and the Curative Animal Salve after you gather the needed reagents.

faq.q: Who do I report to after curing the animals?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: After curing the animals, you report to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade’s druidic sanctuary. You use your teleportation magic to reach the sacred grove.

faq.q: Why is the Cenarion Circle interested in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle watches over the land’s harmony. Sickness among wild gazelles reflects the corruption creeping through Kalimdor, which threatens the natural order if left unchecked.

faq.q: What ability does this quest chain unlock?
faq.answer: This rite of passage is the second half of a druidic trial. It ultimately grants you the ability to cleanse venoms and toxins from yourself and your allies.

aliases: who can do curing the sick
faq.answer: No. Only druids can undertake this line of work. It is a class trial supervised directly by the Cenarion Circle.

angles.text: As a druid, this rite of healing marks your passage from herbalism student to active guardian of nature. It proves you are ready to wield life magic against lethal poisons.
As your people renew their ancient ties to the Cenarion Circle, healing the Barrens shows that the Earth Mother’s children are worthy stewards of the balance.
By treating afflicted wildlife near the Crossroads, tauren druids help protect the essential hunting grounds and travel corridors that support the Horde’s foothold in central Kalimdor.
